findings.statement: Replacing scalar total capacity with the unordered per-column capacity multiset removes most remaining REL_INC-ZOE collisions, reducing 4x4-k4 from 10 to 2 mixed classes and 4x5-k4 from 317 to 41.
The exact unordered capacity profile remains Q-V inexact on 4x4-k4 and 4x5-k4.

The first surviving collisions preserve REL_INC and the exact unordered capacity profile but differ in exact component identity, localizing the next structurally grounded test to the alignment between column capacity state and residual-incidence column role.

nonclaims: Capacity-to-incidence role alignment is not yet proved sufficient.
Exact role-aligned capacity is not selected as the final quotient; it is only a reconstruction control.
next_question: What is the coarsest jointly canonicalized role-aligned column-capacity labeling that preserves Q-V under ZOE aggregation: capacity parity, zero/positive-odd/positive-even, or exact capacity?
